description.p: Fetch random and search-based wallpapers from Wallhaven.cc with slideshow controls, collections, favorites, filters, crossfade, Ken Burns, disk cache, and desktop actions.
Requires network access to wallhaven.cc. An optional API key unlocks NSFW content and favorites.
Hotfix: stop notification floods from retries/filters; isolate per-screen sync groups so search no longer overwrites every monitor; keep next/pause fan-out.
Daily-driver update: API key auth UX, cache warm/prune/quota, trip mode, plasmoid search history and purity toggles, notification actions, and settings undo.
Hotfix: stop saving stringified D-Bus replies as the Wallhaven API key (which caused persistent 401 errors); scrub bad keys on startup.
Offline tag playlists and cache browser filters, multi-monitor plasmoid controls, desktop/offline one-click profiles, searchable preset gallery, and more translations.
Cache tags for smarter day/night offline picks, named local folder playlists, plasmoid settings shortcut and status tips, plus expanded DE/FR/ES/IT translations.
Compact plasmoid with search and cache pin, Simple-mode polish, local-folder depth/exclude/sort, day-aware smart offline, preset gallery tiles, and lock-screen sync status.
Hotfix: run config schema migration before KWallet API-key load; always scrub secrets from bug-report exports; CI asserts 3.0 config keys.

Major settings refresh: Simple/Advanced UI, config schema v3 migration, local folder browse mode, smart offline cache picks, reduced-motion accessibility, secret-scrubbing exports, typed D-Bus status helpers, and per-monitor plasmoid control.
Fix blank wallpaper settings panel caused by a duplicate visible property on the browse-mode control.
Settings filter hides non-matching rows; offline playlist browse mode; collection URL parse and name filter; wallpaper details sheet; API health and rate-limit visibility; KWallet save for API keys.

Distribution and polish: config-wiring audit treats typed cfg_* bindings as real, offline CI smoke, collections by username, HTTP/JSON preset import, laptop power-saving preset, longer seen-history with clear, wallpaper info action, per-screen sync-group helper, and bug-report file export.

Hardening and polish: CI config-wiring audit, preset browser with full snapshots, more-like-current browse mode, optional cache original download, idle slideshow pause, per-group sync profiles, panel blur strength, offline empty-cache notification, plasmoid tags and recent menu entry, and setup wizard status for D-Bus/upscaler/shortcuts.

Feature-wiring fixes: prefer sharper matches and weather-reactive search now reach the wallpaper picker and query builder; music-reactive pacing and screen-lock pause unwrap D-Bus replies correctly; settings JSON fields use Plasma cfg bindings; plasmoid history/status parse ReadTextFile replies reliably.

Settings panel now polls D-Bus itself and binds to a live wallpaper property, so the "service is not running" banner clears when wallhaven-dbus.service is actually up. Upscaler status is polled the same way and no longer stays on "Checking…". The wallpaper history gallery reads from the live wallpaper instead of a blank config snapshot. Disk cache slots roll again: the slot count is a ceiling, and the oldest unused unpinned wallpaper is aged out when a new one is cached.

Three opt-in image-quality features (resolution/aspect-aware selection, brightness/contrast/saturation filters, an external AI upscaler hook for low-res matches with a retroactive re-upscale option) plus six correctness fixes: system theme sync color format, "small" image quality ordering, overlapping transitions, pinned disk-cache slot eviction, D-Bus availability detection, and screen-lock-based slideshow pausing.
Fun release: swipe-to-rate on the panel widget, music- and weather-reactive slideshow, time-capsule scheduled searches, wider accent theme sync, and opt-in milestone/streak notifications.
Preset import and apply actually work, per-screen disk cache, working parallax pan, lock-screen sync via Plasma Image keys, and client-side category/purity filtering.
Italian i18n, shortcuts CMake fix, control and KDE Store docs, settings filter hint, PKGBUILD global shortcuts, and real desktop screenshot.
Spanish i18n, KGlobalAccel shortcuts, plasmoid v3 controls, Variety watch mode, settings D-Bus banner, Flatpak CI smoke, and CONTRIBUTING translator guide.
French i18n, unified translation pipeline, KDE Store screenshot gallery, plasmoid local cache thumbnails, D-Bus offline hints, packaging smoke CI, and automatic AUR publish on release tags.
Stable 2.0 milestone: complete Plasma 6 port with MPRIS, KRunner, D-Bus control, German i18n, Flatpak manifest, AppStream screenshots, and production packaging.
Settings import via D-Bus, slideshow rules auto-resume, debug log hardening, attribution layout fix, and complete downstream packaging with locales and systemd.
Plasmashell stability fixes: D-Bus file I/O, inline settings wizard, cache URL correction, and layout anchor cleanup.
Full German translation, Variety bridge apply, live MPRIS metadata updates, screenshot capture workflow, and complete downstream packaging.

MPRIS media controls, wallhaven:// preset URL handler, KRunner/plasmoid extras, auto panel accent, smart color search, slideshow rules, debug metrics, community presets, and downstream packaging stubs.

Setup wizard, settings filter, wallpaper of the day, favorites refresh, debug log, cache manager with pins, adaptive preload, WebP filter, curated presets with share URLs, KRunner plugin, D-Bus player API, and automation examples.

Tag blocklist, weekday/weekend schedules, multi-collection rotation, wallpaper history gallery, lock screen sync, slide/zoom/random transitions, parallax, panel tint metadata, Variety symlink, plasmoid v2 with countdown, D-Bus control, and global shortcut helpers.

Similar wallpapers, file type filter, search/API validation, slideshow jitter and day/night intervals, fade-through-black, attribution controls, control bus and plasmoid, sync advance, metered cache-only, KWallet, Variety metadata, and settings export to file.
Copy tags/URL, blocklist, search presets, settings import/export, offline-only mode, smarter rate-limit backoff, and cache file deletion.
Collection picker, slideshow pause, offline cache fallback, dual preload, wake/reconnect handling, and shipping polish.
Initial Plasma 6 release with search, collections, favorites, effects, and performance optimizations.
